take: Per VGK's announcement, Victor Olofsson goes on injured reserve and Ville Heinola is recalled from Henderson (AHL). Olofsson has four goals in six games, about 2.4 more than the chances he's had would suggest, so some of that output was running hot. Even so, VGK have controlled play with him on the ice. Going by how the coach has used his players, Jonas Rondbjerg (11:42 a night) is next in line for his minutes. Heinola has played two games this season, with one assist.
